proposed_widenings.name: ModifySpeedOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: Longstrider's sole combat-relevant mechanic is a numeric speed increase (+10 ft) that persists on the target for the duration. The existing OngoingOperation union (roll_modifier | damage_on_hit) has no variant for this. The v4 atom modify_speed exists in the taxonomy but is unreachable from the surface. A new OngoingOperation variant { kind: 'modify_speed'; deltaFeet: number } would cover Longstrider cleanly and generalise to any spell or feature that buffs or debuffs movement speed (Slow, Haste speed component, Barbarian Fast Movement, etc.).
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

notes: The overall ongoing_effect family fits Longstrider exactly. Attachment (touch target, choose_up_to with linear slot scaling), duration (timed 1 hour), and higher-level scaling (one additional creature per slot above 1) are all already expressible. The only blocking gap is the absence of a modify_speed OngoingOperation variant. No other widening is needed.
